description: Server-side (or async) data provider for TmDataTable. Implement this interface to power sorting, filtering, and pagination from an API or database. For in-memory scenarios, use InMemoryDataProvider<TItem> from Tempo.Blazor.

typeParameters.name: TItem
typeParameters.description: The item type returned by the provider.

methods.name: GetDataAsync
methods.description: Fetches a page of data applying the given query (sort, filter, search, page).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Query parameters including pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: GetGroupedDataAsync
methods.description: Fetches grouped data from the server with per-group pagination. Called when DataTableQuery.GroupByColumns is non-empty. Default implementation returns null, which causes the component to fall back to client-side grouping via GetDataAsync.

examples.title: API-based implementation
Usage in DataTable
examples.code:
<TmDataTable TItem="ProductDto" DataProvider="@_productProvider">
    <TmDataTableColumn Field="@(p => p.Name)" Title="Name" />
    <TmDataTableColumn Field="@(p => p.Price)" Title="Price" />
</TmDataTable>

@code {
    private IDataTableDataProvider<ProductDto> _productProvider = 
        new ApiDataProvider<ProductDto>(_api, "/api/products");
}
